intro.zh: 涵蓋逆向設計、教材製作、測驗與評量規準、差異化教學：檢查你知道哪些環節需要教師把關。80 分通過；本測驗為課程自編練習，非 Anthropic 官方認證。
intro.en: Covers backward design, materials, quizzes and rubrics, and differentiated instruction: do you know where the teacher must stay in charge? Pass at 80. A course-made practice quiz, not an official Anthropic certification.

q.zh: 你要為「生活科技專題」設計一門課，採逆向設計。第一步最合理的是什麼？
q.en: You are designing a 'everyday technology project' course using backward design. What is the most sensible first step?

opts.zh: 先釐清學生學完要能做到什麼（學習目標），再設計怎麼評量
opts.en: Clarify what students should be able to do (learning goals), then design how to assess it

opts.zh: 先請 Claude 排出十八週的活動，最後再想目標
opts.en: Have Claude schedule eighteen weeks of activities and think about goals last

opts.zh: 先挑選喜歡的教材，目標等課程結束再補
opts.en: Pick favorite materials first and add goals after the course ends

opts.zh: 直接沿用去年的週次表，不需調整
opts.en: Reuse last year's weekly plan with no changes

why.zh: 逆向設計先定學習目標與評量證據，再安排活動；Claude 可協助拆解，但目標由教師決定。
why.en: Backward design sets goals and assessment evidence first, then activities; Claude can help break it down, but the teacher decides the goals.

q.zh: 風機維護課要加入「上鎖掛牌」安全評量，Claude 產出了一份評量草案。最適當的做法是？
q.en: A wind-turbine maintenance course adds a lockout-tagout safety assessment and Claude drafted it. What is the most appropriate handling?

opts.zh: 交給有現場經驗的教師與安全負責人審閱，確認步驟與用語後才使用
opts.en: Have an instructor and safety officer with field experience review and confirm the steps and wording before use

opts.zh: Claude 寫的就是標準程序，直接發給學生
opts.en: Treat Claude's text as the standard procedure and hand it to students

opts.zh: 刪掉安全題以免出錯
opts.en: Delete the safety items to avoid errors

opts.zh: 只要題目夠多，內容不必審閱
opts.en: Skip review as long as there are enough items

why.zh: AI 提供草案與建議；涉及設備操作的安全程序一律由教師與現場人員確認。
why.en: AI provides drafts and suggestions; safety procedures involving equipment are always confirmed by instructors and field staff.

q.zh: 你要用 Claude 做手電筒歐姆定律的講義與例題，並讓學生分級練習。下列哪個做法最好？
q.en: You want Claude to build a flashlight Ohm's-law handout with graded practice. Which approach is best?

opts.zh: 請它依難度產生例題與解答，教師再核對計算與單位
opts.en: Ask for problems and solutions by difficulty, then verify the calculations and units yourself

opts.zh: 全部照單全收，因為計算機器不會錯
opts.en: Accept everything because machines never make mistakes

opts.zh: 只問「做一份講義」，不說明對象與程度
opts.en: Ask only 'make a handout' without audience or level

opts.zh: 要求它省略解答，以免學生看到
opts.en: Ask it to omit solutions so students never see them

why.zh: 給對象與程度能讓教材更貼切；例題數值與單位仍須教師核對。
why.en: Giving audience and level makes materials fit better; the teacher still checks values and units.

q.zh: 你想把風機葉片檢測的現場照片放進教材，請 Claude 協助整理。上傳前最該注意什麼？
q.en: You want to put blade-inspection field photos into course material with Claude's help. What matters most before uploading?

opts.zh: 確認有權使用，並去除可辨識的案場、人員或客戶資訊
opts.en: Confirm you may use them and remove identifiable site, personnel or client information

opts.zh: 照片越高解析越好，其他不必處理
opts.en: Higher resolution is all that matters

opts.zh: 只要上傳的是 PDF 就沒有著作權問題
opts.en: PDFs never raise copyright issues

opts.zh: 讓 Claude 自行判斷哪些可以公開
opts.en: Let Claude decide what is safe to publish

why.zh: 教材用的圖片要注意授權與去識別；是否可公開由人負責判斷。
why.en: Images in teaching material need permission and de-identification; people decide what can be shared.

q.zh: 電路單元的科學小測驗，選擇題有一題大家都選同一個錯誤選項。依誘答選項設計，最合理的解讀是？
q.en: In a circuits quiz, most students pick the same wrong option on one item. Using distractor design, what is the most sensible reading?

opts.zh: 這個誘答選項反映了常見迷思，可據此補充教學並修訂題目
opts.en: That distractor reflects a common misconception; use it to adjust teaching and revise the item

opts.zh: 學生都在亂猜，不必處理
opts.en: Students are guessing, nothing to do

opts.zh: 應把所有選項改成一樣長
opts.en: Make all options identical

opts.zh: 把正確答案固定放在第一個
opts.en: Always place the correct answer first

why.zh: 好的誘答選項對應常見迷思，作答分布能幫助改進教學與題目。
why.en: Good distractors map to common misconceptions; response patterns help improve teaching and items.

q.zh: PLC 實作課要請 Claude 協助評分。下列哪個做法最符合「自動批改的界線」？
q.en: In a PLC lab course you want Claude to help with grading. Which practice best fits the limits of automated grading?

opts.zh: 用明確的評分規準請它初評並說明理由，教師複核並保有最終評分權
opts.en: Give a clear rubric for a first pass with reasons, while the instructor reviews and keeps final say

opts.zh: 成績直接由 Claude 決定並公布
opts.en: Claude decides and publishes grades directly

opts.zh: 不提供規準，讓它自行決定標準
opts.en: Give no rubric and let it set its own standard

opts.zh: PLC 程式只要能跑就一律滿分
opts.en: Any PLC program that runs gets full marks

why.zh: 規準明確能提升一致性，但評分的責任與最終決定屬於教師。
why.en: A clear rubric improves consistency, but grading responsibility and final decisions stay with the teacher.

q.zh: 你把同一篇科普短文改成不同閱讀程度版本。哪個要求最能維持教學品質？
q.en: You adapt one science article to several reading levels. Which request best protects quality?

opts.zh: 要求保留核心概念不變，只調整詞彙與句子難度，並由教師審閱
opts.en: Keep core concepts unchanged, adjust only vocabulary and sentence difficulty, and review as the teacher

opts.zh: 為了簡單，把有難度的概念全部刪除
opts.en: Delete every difficult concept to keep it simple

opts.zh: 讓每個版本各自重新解釋、不必一致
opts.en: Let each version re-explain freely with no consistency

opts.zh: 不要審閱，直接發給學生
opts.en: Skip review and distribute

why.zh: 分級改寫要保留核心概念；專有名詞與正確性由教師審閱。
why.en: Leveled rewriting keeps the core concepts; terminology and accuracy are checked by the teacher.

q.zh: 你想讓 Claude 在「控制原理」專案的所有對話都先給提示、不直接給答案，又不影響其他對話。依 Claude 支援文章，適合怎麼做？
q.en: You want Claude to give hints rather than answers in every 'control principles' conversation without affecting other chats. According to Claude's support articles, what fits best?

opts.zh: 把要求寫進該 Project 的專屬指令，只會作用於這個專案內的對話
opts.en: Put it in that Project's instructions, which apply only to chats inside that project

opts.zh: 改寫帳號層級的設定，讓所有對話都套用
opts.en: Change account-level settings so every chat uses it

opts.zh: 每次都手動重貼，因為指令無法儲存
opts.en: Re-paste it every time because instructions cannot be saved

opts.zh: 在 CLAUDE.md 寫一次，所有網頁對話就會遵守
opts.en: Write it once in CLAUDE.md and all web chats obey it

why.zh: Project 的專屬指令只作用於該專案內的對話；帳號層級設定則影響所有對話（資訊截至 2026-11，以官方最新說明為準）。
why.en: Project instructions apply only within that project, while account-level settings affect all chats (as of 2026-11; check official docs for updates).
